bullets.text: Building a Smarter Workforce - **Innovorg** transforms workforce management with AI insights for skill gaps and training needs.
5G Innovations Ahead - **Spirent** predicts 5G SA will dominate, unlocking new monetization opportunities for operators in 2026.
Wi-Fi Performance Focus - The **iPhone 17** showcases significant improvements in Wi-Fi speeds, challenging Android flagships.
Scaling Private 5G - Enterprises navigate spectrum and deployment challenges to adopt **private 5G** networks effectively.
Nokia Job Cuts - **Nokia** plans to close its Munich site, resulting in 700 job losses as part of restructuring.
AT&T's Network Upgrade - **AT&T** enhances its 5G network with new spectrum from **Echostar**, boosting speeds significantly.
Amazon Leo Launch - **Amazon** rebrands its satellite initiative to **Amazon Leo**, competing with **SpaceX**'s **Starlink**.
Viasat's Capacity Boost - **Viasat** launches a new satellite to dynamically increase bandwidth where needed in real-time.
Verizon Layoffs Planned - **Verizon** prepares to cut 15,000 jobs as part of a restructuring strategy under new leadership.
Meta's Subsea Cable Complete - **Meta** completes the **2Africa** subsea cable, enhancing connectivity across multiple regions.
